'''Replicator''' was the name given to a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] created by [[Mentor]], the leader of the [[Directive 7]] movement during the era of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Replicator was a prototype droid based on fragments of a self-replicating [[Droid/Legends|droid]] technology that Mentor had discovered; Replicator was capable of breaking into multiple smaller versions of itself, which were also able to break apart and multiply. However, Replicator was [[Death/Legends|destroyed]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Zadd]] during the collapse of the movement.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Replicator appears as a bonus boss in the Flashpoint "Directive 7" in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
